From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>

Subject: Quick follow-up & next steps — Redwood Hosted API eval

Thanks again for taking the demo today, Emily — really appreciate you and the product team carving out time. High-level recap and next steps below so we’re aligned.

Recap (what we covered):
- Demo: low-latency text generation, streaming responses, and embeddings for semantic search.
- Deployment options: Hosted API (fastest to begin), Dedicated capacity (reserved GPU pools / predictable throughput), Private (VPC / on-prem for strict data residency).
- Observability: per-route latency & token costs, tracing, and rollouts.

Your stated priorities: product POC first, then evaluate throughput/cost, and confirm data residency & security needs for production.

Answers / immediate items:
1) Quickstart: you can spin up a Hosted API eval in minutes — docs and step-by-step guide attached (redwood-quickstart-guide.pdf) and at https://docs.redwood.ai/quickstart.
2) Endpoints: base API is https://api.redwood.ai/v1/ with endpoints for /chat, /completions, /embeddings. Sample curl is in the guide.
3) Rate limits (Hosted eval defaults): 60 requests/minute per API key (burst to 100) and token throughput of 10,000 tokens/minute. If you need higher throughput for a short POC, we can temporarily raise limits — see https://console.redwood.ai/requests/increase-rate-limits.
4) Security & compliance: Hosted is SOC 2 compliant; we can enable customer KMS for encryption at rest. For strict data residency or air-gapped requirements, Private VPC / on-prem is the path (we can discuss timing/ops).

Suggested next steps:
- Marissa to provision a Hosted API eval project + $5k trial credits (I’ll do this after you confirm).
- Technical 30-min POC call with Lauren (cc) to validate throughput & integration — can she do Wed/Thu this week?
- Emily to confirm which endpoints you want to exercise (chat vs embeddings) and any IP allowlist or SSO requirements.

Attachments: redwood-quickstart-guide.pdf, rate-limits-and-pricing-summary.csv

Thanks — happy to start the POC ASAP.

Best,

1) Data residency: for our EU customers we need logs and customer content to stay in EU. Does Hosted API offer region selection for EU-only processing?
2) SSO/SCIM: do you support SSO for the console and SCIM for provisioning service accounts?

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Quick follow-up & next steps — Redwood Hosted API eval

Thanks Emily — great questions. Answers inline below and next steps at the end.

1) Data residency:
- Hosted API: we operate regional endpoints and can restrict processing to a region for many accounts. For EU-only processing we can enable the EU region (data stays in-region). For contractual guarantees and fully air-gapped requirements, our Private (VPC/on-prem) offering is used. I’ll flag this as a requirement on the POC so our solutions team can confirm regional enforcement.

2) SSO/SCIM:
- Yes, we support SSO for the Console (SAML/OIDC) and SCIM for user provisioning. Service accounts for the API are API keys; for enterprise we offer token introspection and SSO-backed admin access.

3) Throughput and tokens:
- Token accounting: tokens are counted per request irrespective of streaming or non-streaming; streaming simply changes how responses are delivered.
- Defaults for Hosted eval: 60 requests/min per API key, burst to 100; typical concurrent request guidance is keep concurrent requests under 10 per key for best latency. Token throughput default is ~10,000 tokens/min per project during eval.
- If you need sustained higher concurrency/throughput for the POC, we can set temporary increases — our ops team typically provisions increased rate limits for a 2–4 week POC window.

4) Pricing estimate for 1M tokens/week (3 months):
- I attached a short pricing worksheet (rate-limits-and-pricing-summary.csv) with example math. Roughly: Hosted API list pricing ~ $X.XX per 1k tokens for generations; we’ll do a tailored quote once we know model & prompt lengths.

Next steps:
- I will provision a Hosted eval project and seed it with $5k in trial credits once you confirm — can you confirm we should go ahead?
- Lauren (cc) from Solutions can run the technical POC Wed 10–11am PT — Lauren, can you take that slot?
- If confirmed, I’ll also open a temporary rate-limit increase request so you have headroom for the POC (link: https://console.redwood.ai/requests/increase-rate-limits).

Let me know and I’ll get everything spun up today.

Best,
